description: HP lt4112 LTE/HSPA+ Gobi 4G: a Huawei ME906E under HP's VID 03f0:581d, so the generic huawei profile (VID 12d1) does not see it. Linux 6.12 binds it as a Gobi module: qcserial with the Huawei interface layout (DEVICE_HWI) and qmi_wwan on the vendor-class function (subclass 01, protocol 07), so its data path is QMI, not Huawei NCM. ModemManager's Huawei plugin only takes VID 12d1: the generic plugin owns it over QMI. Radio over AT is still the Huawei dialect. another modem manager 3.5.8 reads it with its Huawei E3272/E3372 metrics (AT^HCSQ). Reference only, no bench of ours; profiles audit 2026-10-19

radio.source: Linux 6.12 qcserial.c (DEVICE_HWI 03f0:581d, HP lt4112 = Huawei ME906E) and qmi_wwan.c; another modem manager 3.5.8 modem/usb/03f0581d (AT^HCSQ)
